verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no natural-language command interface or built-in AI assistant for Logseq. The closest items fall short. Simple `{{query ...}}` is text matching, not natural-language command execution. The local HTTP API and the `logseq://` protocol are programmatic surfaces an external agent could call, but nothing shows the product accepting natural-language commands. One community comment about using Claude/Codex to edit pages describes external tools writing files, and it says this no longer works in the new version.
